scope: Exact-fenced recovery of stale dispatched GBP write grants through the regular dual-sync health cron

scenarios.scenario: A provider write was dispatched, finalize persistence was lost, and the later health path terminalized it as outcome_unknown, cancelled later claimed bundle grants, reconciled its terminal notice, and performed zero provider re-emissions.
scenarios.observable: 6 test files and 81 tests passed; health recovery invocation precedes terminal notice reconciliation; fake provider transport retained exactly its one original invocation; reconciliation reports its global terminal notice materialization count without attributing unrelated notices to recovery.

scenarios.scenario: Only stale dispatched grants behind the five-minute cutoff and exact current tenant/profile fence are recovered; stale/cross-tenant fences fail, replay is idempotent, later dispatch is rejected, and bundle events are terminalized atomically.
scenarios.invocation: PostgreSQL exact-current schema driver for recover_stale_gbp_dispatched_grants_v1
scenarios.observable: stale_dispatch_cutoff_fence_limit, stale_dispatch_recovery_idempotent_no_reemit, stale_dispatch_terminalizes_bundle_events, and final driver probes report result=pass.

scenarios.scenario: Runtime work is bounded and starvation-resistant.
scenarios.observable: Candidate enumeration starts from at most 500 oldest stale dispatched grants, derives at most 50 current profile fences, requests at most 100 recoveries per fence, stops at 500 recovered grants globally, and recovered candidates naturally leave the next scan.

scenarios.scenario: Dry-run and partial failure reporting are truthful and safe.
scenarios.observable: dryRun reports mode=dry_run_omitted with zero mutation/reconciliation calls; per-profile RPC failure returns only restaurant/profile identifiers and grant_recovery_failed, marks completion telemetry warning, and does not reflect provider/database error bodies.

scenarios.scenario: Scoped lint, formatting, forbidden-pattern audit, and repository whitespace validation
scenarios.invocation: ESLint, Prettier check, scoped forbidden-pattern scan, and git diff --check
scenarios.observable: all checks exited 0 and matched files use Prettier code style

operationalContract.dryRun: mutation and notice reconciliation omitted explicitly
operationalContract.ordering: grant recovery before terminal notice reconciliation
